title: BattleFanz
tagline: Step up your fan engagement game, unlock rewards for your community.
description:
BattleFanz is a treasure hunt game to reward loyal fans and add a sense of adventure before the game. Embark on a treasure hunt over a history lesson on football as you've never seen before. 

BattleFanz is built on the Chiliz blockchain and uses fan tokens that a player holds. The location based challenges are completed using a reprogrammed NFC chip provided by Nouns DAO
how_its_made: BattleFanz is an iOS app that checks the user against their fan tokens for a chance to play. Preprogrammed NFC tags have been placed at select locations for fans to unlock special rewards in Chiliz tokens that are airdropped upon successful completion of the game. For the artwork, we've used the fun, playful style of Nouns to keep it Nounish.
